transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for fitting me in. I, uh, I hope I'm doing this right. 

Well, my supervisor at the building said I should come talk to someone because... I guess my talking gets a little mixed up sometimes. It's nothing too bad, I promise, it's just... I'll try to explain something, like about my work keys, and then somehow I'm talking about the jail, and then the prayer rug, and then the chess pieces. And... well, people tell me they just cannot follow what I'm saying. 

I don't mean to confuse anybody, I really try hard to be clear. Does that make sense, how I just explained it? I hope I'm not wasting your time.
Do you often find it difficult to stay on topic when talking to others?

Yes, doctor, I guess I do. Like I was just saying a second ago, I really don't mean to drift off. I try so hard to just give a straight answer, I promise I do. But, yeah, I'll be talking about my janitor keys, and then... well, the jail comes up in my head, and then the prayer rug, and the chess pieces. 

I know I just told you those exact things, I'm sorry to repeat myself. It's just that my brain connects them all together, but other folks tell me they can't follow me at all when I do that. It's not all the time, just... often enough that my boss noticed. I hope that answers your question okay? I'm really trying to give you the right information.
Do you ever hear voices or see things that aren't there?

Oh, um... well... I know this sounds bad, and I really don't want you to think I'm, you know, crazy or anything. I'm a good worker, I promise. But... sometimes, yeah. 

It's not all the time, just... occasionally, when I'm at work. I'll be near the vents or maybe in the mop closet, and I'll hear a man's voice. He, um... he says my name, or he tells me I ruined everything. And it's not like a thought in my head, doctor, it sounds just as real as you sitting right there. 

I try to ignore it, I really do. I just keep my head down and keep cleaning. Is that... is that normal for people to experience sometimes? I hope I'm not scaring you by telling you that.
How long do you usually hear the man's voice when it happens?

Um, well... I'm not exactly sure, to be honest. I hope that's an okay answer. I just... I try not to pay attention to it, you know? I don't sit there and time it. 

I guess it's just a few seconds, maybe? It's really quick, I promise. Just a passing thing. I don't let it distract me from my work or anything like that. I just keep sweeping or mopping. Does that sound alright? I mean, I don't want you to think it's a big problem or that it's taking up my whole day. It's really not that bad.
Do you feel like your thoughts are disconnected from each other when this happens?

Well, um... I guess that's sort of what I was trying to explain earlier, about my talking getting all mixed up. I hope it's okay that I brought that up before you asked. 

It's just... yeah, when the talking gets jumbled, it's like my thoughts are doing the same thing. I'll be trying to explain something simple, like the keys, and then my brain just jumps to the jail, and then the prayer rug, and the chess pieces. It makes sense to me in the moment, I swear it does, but... well, like I said, people tell me they just cannot follow what I'm saying at all. 

I really try to keep it all straight, doctor, I promise. I don't want to sound like I don't know what I'm talking about. Is it... is it bad that my thoughts jump around like that? I'm really trying my best to make sense for you.
Do you have difficulty performing your daily tasks or work duties due to your mixed-up thoughts or hearing voices?

Oh, um... well, I really try to push through it. I want you to know I'm a very hard worker, I really am. But... I guess, if I'm being completely honest—and I hope you won't be disappointed in me—it has caused a few hiccups. 

I've, um... I've missed some shifts. And I actually lost some of my cleaning work recently. It's not that I'm lazy, I swear! It's just... people tell me they can't rely on me, or they complain that they just can't understand what I'm saying when my words get mixed up. I hate feeling like I'm letting people down or bothering them. So I've actually just stopped going to the mosque, and I don't go to family gatherings anymore, either. I figure it's better if I just stay out of their way, you know? 

And... well, I'm really ashamed to admit this, but... there have been a few times where things got a little overwhelming, and I guess I wasn't being very safe. Other people actually had to call for emergency help for me. I felt terrible causing such a big fuss, I really didn't mean to scare anybody. 

I really am trying to get better, doctor, I promise I am. Please tell me you don't think I'm a lost cause? I just want to do a good job.
Do you have difficulty taking care of your personal needs, such as bathing or dressing?

Um, well... I try my best to keep up with things, I really do. I don't want you to think I'm just letting myself go. But... I guess, if I'm being honest, there are some days where it's a little harder. I hope that's an okay thing to admit.

Sometimes... like on my really bad days, after I finish my morning prayer, I just... I end up sitting on the edge of my bed. And I get this really heavy, empty feeling. It's like... well, it just feels like there's no point in cleaning myself up or even going outside. I just sit there. 

I know I should get up and get dressed, and I feel awful that I don't always do it. I'm really trying to push past it, I promise. Does that make sense? I hope you don't think I'm just being lazy... I really want to be better about it.
Do you often have trouble completing tasks or activities due to feeling disorganized?

Um... well, I really try to finish everything I start. I pride myself on being a good worker, I really do. But... I guess sometimes things do get a little... scattered. I hope you don't think I'm doing it on purpose. 

It's just... like, if I'm at work and I'm trying to mop a floor, right? I'll be doing my best, but then if just one door closes down the hall, or if a fluorescent light starts buzzing... it just pulls me completely away. My attention just snaps right to it. And then, before I even realize what I'm doing, I'm over checking the window, or I'm touching my keys, or I'm starting a whole new cleaning job before the first one is even done. 

I feel so bad when it happens because I really don't mean to leave things half-finished. I want to be reliable for people. Is it... is it normal to get distracted that easily? I really hope you know I'm trying my absolute best to stay on track.
Do you experience these mixed-up thoughts and hearing voices most of the time?

Oh, um... I'm really not sure if it's most of the time. I hope you're not upset with me that I don't have an exact answer for you. 

I try so hard to just keep my head down and do my job, so I haven't really been keeping a close track of how often it happens. I definitely don't want you to think I'm completely out of it all day long, because I really do try to have good stretches where I'm just normal and focused. It's just... hard to say for sure how much of the day it takes up. 

I really hope I'm still being helpful to you. Am I giving you the right kind of information? I just want to make sure I'm doing this right.
Have you had to stop doing things you enjoy or stop spending time with friends and family because of your thoughts or the voice you hear?

Um, well... I hope you don't think badly of me for saying this, but... yes, it has affected things a little bit. I really try to be a good family man and a good worker, I promise. But... sometimes the thoughts and the voices just make it so hard. 

I've, um... I've had to miss a few shifts at work. And I lost some cleaning jobs because of it. I feel terrible about it, I really do. People have told me they can't rely on me anymore, or that they just don't understand what I'm saying. So... I've sort of stopped going to the mosque as much, and I don't really join in on family gatherings lately. I just don't want to be a burden or make anyone uncomfortable. 

And, um... I guess I should tell you, just so I'm being completely honest... there were a couple of times where things got a bit out of hand, and people felt like they needed to call for emergency help because I wasn't being safe. I'm so embarrassed about that. I really don't want you to think I'm a dangerous person or anything. I just... I get overwhelmed sometimes. Is it okay that I'm telling you all this? I really want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
Have you noticed a significant decline in your ability to function at work or in social situations over time?

Um... I know we just touched on this a little, and I really hope I'm not repeating myself too much. I want to make sure I'm answering exactly what you're asking. 

But, yes... I guess you could say there's been a decline. I mean, I always try to be a hard worker, I really do. But like I mentioned, I've missed some shifts and... well, I actually lost some of my cleaning jobs. It's so embarrassing to admit, but people started saying they couldn't rely on me, or that they just couldn't make sense of what I was saying to them. 

And socially... yeah, it's gotten harder. I stopped going to the mosque, and I don't really go to family things anymore. I just don't want to upset anyone or be a bother. And... well, I know I said this too, but there were those times when things got so confusing for me that people felt they had to call for emergency help because I wasn't being safe. 

I'm really trying to get better, though. I hope you know that. Does that answer your question? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the full picture like you need.
Do you often find yourself engaging in behaviors that seem unusual or out of place to others?

Oh, um... I really hope not. I try very hard to just... blend in, I guess. I don't think I do anything too unusual or out of place. At least, I haven't really noticed anything like that myself. 

I mostly just try to keep to myself and do my work quietly so I don't bother anybody. I really don't want to make a bad impression on people, you know? 

Have... have I been doing something out of place while talking to you today? I just want to make sure I'm behaving okay and not doing anything wrong. I hope I'm acting normal for you.
Do you often find yourself doing things that don't make sense to you or others when you're not hearing the voice?

Um... no, I don't think so. When it's quiet, when the voice isn't there, I just try to do my normal routine. I really try to be sensible and do things the right way. 

I mean, I don't think I do anything that doesn't make sense. I mostly just clean up around my apartment or watch a little TV. Just... normal things, you know? I really try my best to be a good, normal person when I have a clear head. 

I hope that's the right answer. I'm not doing anything wrong by just trying to keep busy, am I? I just want to make sure I'm doing what I'm supposed to do.
Do you often find yourself doing things without a clear reason or purpose?

Um... no, I don't really think I do that. I try to make sure everything I do has a reason, you know? Like, if I'm walking somewhere, it's to go to the store, or if I'm cleaning, it's because something needs to be cleaned. 

I really try to be purposeful and not just... waste time or act strange. I want to make sure I'm doing things the right way, the way people are supposed to do them. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right. I just really try to be a responsible person and have a good reason for the things I do. I'm not doing anything that seems like it doesn't have a purpose, right?
How long have you been experiencing these mixed-up thoughts and hearing voices?

Um... well, it's been a little while now. I mean, it's not like it's been my whole life or anything, so I'm not totally crazy, I promise. 

I guess... the voices, and that really scary feeling that people are watching me or that I'm marked somehow... it's been about a year and a half. Maybe a little less? I try really hard not to let it interfere with my cleaning work, though. I still show up and do my job. 

Is a year and a half a really long time? I should have come in sooner, shouldn't I? I'm sorry, I just... I was hoping it would go away if I just kept my head down and worked hard. I hope you're not upset that I waited.
Do you often find yourself doing things in a way that seems disorganized or chaotic to others?

Um... no, sir, I really don't think I do. I mean, with my job—cleaning the building and all—you really have to have a system, right? So I try to be very neat and careful. I don't want anyone thinking I'm making a mess instead of cleaning it up. I always make sure my supply cart is packed right and I put everything away exactly how the supervisor likes it. 

I... I hope nobody has said I was being chaotic? I promise I try my absolute best to keep everything in order and just stay out of people's way. I'm doing okay, aren't I? I just really want to do a good job and not cause any trouble for anyone.
Have you ever felt like you're living in a dream or that things around you aren't real?

Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I know I'm awake, and I know what's real. I go to work, I talk to my supervisor... everything is real, you know? 

I definitely don't feel like I'm dreaming when I'm awake. I try to stay very grounded and focused on my tasks. I know sometimes my thoughts get a little jumbled, but I always know where I am and what I'm doing. 

That's a good thing, right? That I know what's real? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers. I really don't want you to think I'm completely out of touch with everything. I'm trying my best to hold it all together.
Have you ever felt like you've lost touch with reality?

Um... no, sir. I really don't think I've ever completely lost touch with reality. I mean, I know I mentioned the voices and feeling like people are watching me, but I still know who I am and where I am, right? 

I still go to work every day and do my cleaning. If I lost touch with reality, I wouldn't be able to do that, would I? I'd probably get fired, and I definitely haven't been fired. My supervisor says I'm very reliable. 

I know the voices aren't... normal. I know that. But I don't let them take over completely. I fight really hard to stay focused on the real world. That means I haven't lost touch, right? I'm doing the right things to stay grounded, aren't I? I just really want you to know that I'm trying my best to stay in reality.
Are the mixed-up thoughts and voices something that you experience every day?

Um... well, not every single minute of every day, no. I mean, I can still do my job, right? But... yeah, they are around a lot. 

The voices, and that feeling like people are watching me or... or that I've been marked somehow... I guess they've been with me for a while now. Maybe about a year and a half? 

But I've been managing it, you know? I haven't let it ruin my work or anything. A year and a half sounds like a long time, I know, but I've been really careful not to bother anyone else with it. That's good, right? That I've kept it to myself and kept working? I just hope you don't think worse of me because it's been going on for that long. I really am trying my best to handle it.
Do you often find yourself engaging in behaviors that seem unusual or out of place to others, even when you're not hearing the voice?

Um... no, doctor. I really don't think I do anything unusual like that. I try very, very hard to just... just act like everyone else. 

I go in, I get my cart, I do my sweeping and mopping, and I just keep my head down. Nobody at work has ever complained or told me I was acting strange, I promise. I mostly just keep to myself so I don't bother anybody. 

That's a good way to be, isn't it? Just minding my own business and doing my job? I really don't want to make anyone uncomfortable or do anything out of place. I'm just trying to be a good, normal worker. I haven't done anything wrong, have I?
